verdict.rationale: The official README shows one-step commands, `llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF` and `llama serve -hf ...`, that pull a model from a Hugging Face repo and run it, either interactively or as a server. That covers the core of the story directly. The evidence is limited to bare command examples, though, and every example uses a GGUF repo. Missing for 10: documentation of download behavior (caching, quant selection, gated or authenticated models), clarity on whether non-GGUF Hugging Face models can be run directly, and independent hands-on corroboration of the `-hf` workflow.
